description: Hydropower Fish Passage Webmap is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Paul Matson, Bryan Bozeman (Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States)).
